result.title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?
result.summary: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.

AI.brief_summary: 该文考察 LLM 能否仅凭医学知识直接「写出」小型 LeNet 式 CNN 的权重与偏置（weight-space programming），全程不看图像、不做训练优化；在胸片、乳腺超声、腹部 CT 与盆腔 MRI 共 7 个任务上，与零样本 MedSigLIP 及用 256 张标注图 Adam 训练的同架构网络对比，结论是 LLM 写出的网络优于随机、部分超过 MedSigLIP，但始终不及少量数据训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「无任何视觉输入、仅靠参数内先验完成视觉判别」的设定，可能为核查参数先验与视觉证据各自的贡献、以及标注稀缺时视觉处理能力的来源提供对照思路，需较多核查。
